purpose: Post-result stopping-oriented attribution only. No new economic lifecycle, parameter changes, thresholds, filters, or fourth trading consumer.
scope: All 14635 frozen stock-month inputs for all 19795 potential A+B events; all 12241 generated lifecycle rounds; both fixed birth windows.
primary_contrast: CH3_RM minus RAW_MOM11, with original PVR retained as reference. Same-clock RAW controls timing window, not standardization or intercept effects.

new_exante_fields.raw_vol36: sample SD of the same 36 monthly simple stock returns, m-36..m-1
new_exante_fields.raw_vol11: sample SD of the same 11 formation returns, m-12..m-2
new_exante_fields.industry_beta36: OLS with intercept, stock monthly excess return on native same-industry monthly excess return over same 36 months. A total industry sensitivity, not market-neutral industry alpha.
new_exante_fields.industry_source: Original static mapping and industry manifest source, same market month ends, strict endpoint/lineage validity; unknown separately retained.

score_identity: RM - RAW_EXCESS_STANDARDIZED = mean(y)*(1/sd(eps)-1/sd(y)) - alpha/sd(eps) - betaM*mean(M)/sd(eps) - betaS*mean(SMB)/sd(eps) - betaV*mean(VMG)/sd(eps). Exact score arithmetic, not P&L causation.
comparisons: Every fixed original feasible queue with different CH3/RAW selected members; compare exclusive-pick mean pre-entry features at identical day/sector, queue-equal and date-equal means.
All actual admitted rounds in each arm, equal-round descriptive pre-entry feature means/medians with missing counts.
All unique same-stock/same-exit pairs generated by cash attribution, without selecting winners; preserve unmatched and UNKNOWN.
constraints: No fitted predictor of future return
No feature sign reversal or threshold search
No causal claim from descriptive feature differences
No claim unchanged loser amount is an improvement
